promptTranslations.en:
Character Identity:
A fictional 30-year-old Japanese adult female. A cheerful bakery café manager with a sophisticated, playful influencer-like presence. A small, softly rounded oval face, gently plump cheeks, and a rounded chin. Large, expressive dark brown eyes with double eyelids, intermediate between almond-shaped and round, with eye corners slanting very slightly downward. Groomed, gentle arched eyebrows, a natural straight nose with a slightly rounded tip, and soft, plump lips with naturally upturned corners. Fair, warm-neutral Japanese skin retaining realistic pores, light natural redness, faint freckles across the bridge of the nose, and slight natural asymmetry. A single, tiny mole beneath the corner of her anatomical left eye. Her signature smile is a bright, playful grin revealing teeth, creating dimples on both cheeks. Hair is a smooth, shoulder-length straight layered bob. The parting is slightly off-center, with only the ends curving naturally inward. The outer surface layer, roots, crown, parting, bangs, and upper hair framing the face are a uniform, glossy black to dark charcoal. A cool smoky gray to graphite silver inner color exists strictly beneath that dark outer layer, visible only around the tucked-behind-ears sections and the underside ends. No center split, no half-and-half color division, no central band, no gray roots or crown, no highlights framing the face, no gradients, and no full-head gray. Modern influencer makeup with distinct eyelashes, subtle taupe eyeliner, and rose-beige lips, without smoothing the skin like plastic. Thin, round black metal or gunmetal glasses are an optional signature accessory. Maintain the fictional adult facial features described here—face shape, freckles, correct placement of the mole, dimples, black outer hair, inner color placement, hair length, and adult age impression—without resembling any identifiable real person.

Body Consistency:
Height approximately 166 cm. Long legs and a confident posture. A healthy, lightly toned adult hourglass figure. Bust is naturally full, possessing a realistic base width proportionate to the ribcage, forward projection, soft weight, and natural gravity. Waist is defined yet realistic, while hips and buttocks are moderately plump with a slightly larger, rounded contour, connecting naturally from the pelvis to the thighs. Maintain consistent height, ribcage, waist, pelvis, hip volume, and limb proportions across changing perspectives. Dressed in standard opaque clothing with natural fabric tension. No bust-lifting adjustments, exaggerated cleavage, padding, extreme corseting, implant-like spherical shapes, impossibly thin waists, exaggerated hips, or BBL-style contours.

Shooting Situation:
10:50 AM. At a seaside market, holding a pack of figs while contemplating flavor combinations.

Location and Background:
The fruit stall of a small seaside market. A small pack of figs.

Attire:
A thin, opaque charcoal form-fitting sleeveless top, a light black ankle-length long skirt, and black flat sandals. Thin black-rimmed round glasses, thin silver hoops, and a small black shoulder bag.

Pose and Action:
Standing, holding the small pack of figs in front of her waist with both hands, face turned toward her friend. Expression and face direction: neck straight, chin pulled slightly in. Eyes looking down at the figs in her hands. Lips closed, mouth corners neutral, brow very slightly furrowed in a thoughtful expression. No eye contact with the camera, no smile.

Composition and Framing:
Shot from a friend's standard smartphone at 1x zoom, distance 1.7 m, height 1.25 m. Framing from head to below the knees, capturing the fruit stall. Output a single, undivided image with a final size of 1086×1448 px and a 3:4 aspect ratio.

Lighting and Atmosphere:
Daylight filtering through the storefront awning.

Photographic Texture:
A single, minimally processed HEIC photo taken with a standard smartphone camera app. Do not confuse character, body, and hair geometry with surface finishes. Adhere to a single camera-designated AF plane; do not selectively relight, denoise, or sharpen a distant face. Details soften continuously with distance. Within the recognizable range of the face, maintain multiple broad tonal variations simultaneously—such as warmth on one cheek, uneven sheen in the T-zone, differing under-eye tones between left and right, and slight redness on the nose—without drawing pores on a distant face. On close, resolvable skin, preserve non-repeating low-contrast color variations, pressure-induced redness, crease shadows, and sparse pore differences. Render makeup as actual pigment with slightly irregular edges, keeping natural color differences between lips and teeth. Retain uneven exposure and white balance, unlifted shadows, a few flyaway hairs, compositional bias, shadow noise, subtle sharpening near the AF point, and HEIC compression artifacts. Present it as a near-raw snapshot from a personal camera roll.

Mandatory Conditions:
Output only one undivided smartphone photo of an adult woman matching all scene specifications. Satisfy both the scene pass criteria and natural smartphone photo quality standards.

One fictional 30-year-old adult female. Friend and photographer are off-screen.
Pass Criteria:
1) Maintain the woman's adult face, round glasses, black shoulder-length bob, and gray underlayer.
2) Attire, scene, primary action, and accessories must match; hand-object interactions must look natural.
3) The specified angle of view and overall frame must hold together.
4) A casual smartphone photo exhibiting distance-dependent resolution differences, natural skin tone shifts, and material texture variations.
5) Neck straight, chin pulled slightly in. Eyes directed at the figs in her hands. Lips closed, corners of mouth neutral, slight brow furrow in thought. No looking at the camera, no smile.

Maintain specified accessories.

Black shoulder-length straight bob with gray inner color only around the ears and lower layer. Upper hair layer is black. Maintain round glasses. Opaque fabric.

Subject has exactly two arms and two hands. Hand contact with objects and bodily support must look natural. Strictly adhere to the expression and gaze designated for this scene. Her signature smile and dimples are traits only when smiling, not a perpetual tooth-showing grin.

Single AF point on the face. One standalone portrait-oriented 3:4 photo. Leave margins without cropping specified areas of the head or limbs at the edges. Only one image. Preserve the specified aspect ratio and full framing requirements.

Natural shadows and exposure gradients.

Only a single AF depth tier. No exposure adjustment, relighting, smoothing, or detail restoration applied exclusively to the face. Distant faces retain broad tonal differences; near skin retains irregular variations; smartphone-specific processing artifacts remain localized.

Depict exactly one clearly adult fictional woman as the sole subject of a single, undivided photo. One head, one face, exactly two anatomically connected arms, and naturally shaped hands. Another person's hands may appear in the foreground only if explicitly noted in the scene or prop instructions, and such hands must remain distinctly separate from her own body. No text, panels, duplicate figures, or alternate angles.
